name: Astrid Bjornstad
bio:
Astrid's journey into motorsport was somewhat accidental. After earning a degree in fine arts with a focus on automotive design, she initially envisioned a career creating concept cars. However, a chance encounter with a local racing team needing a skilled painter led her down a different path. She discovered a passion for the intricate details and high-pressure environment of motorsport. 

Astrid excels at matching colors perfectly and applying flawless finishes, skills honed over years of experience. Her pragmatic approach ensures the paint jobs are not only aesthetically pleasing but also durable and aerodynamically sound. She is constantly experimenting with new techniques and materials, always striving for the perfect balance between form and function. Her reputation for solving complex paint-related issues makes her an invaluable asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided, often with colorful beads woven in
physical.description: Astrid is a sturdy woman with a focused gaze and hands that show the marks of her craft.

quirks: Always has a small sketchbook and pencil on hand to doodle ideas for paint schemes.
Insists on listening to classical music while working to maintain focus.
Refers to her paint guns by affectionate nicknames.
